blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is set to refer and recommend to the Department of Justice (DOJ) the filing of complaints against 12 officials and contractors of Genesis88 for alleged violations of the Anti-Graft and Corruption Practices Act, according to Director Melvin Matibag. Matibag earlier said that the construction company supposedly bagged P7 billion worth of flood control projects in the first district of Davao City, which is represented in Congress by Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte. Matibag said in an interview with reporters that they would file the recommendation with the DOJ Tuesday afternoon. READ: NBI chief: […]...
